title: Loads before the store

tests.expect: x y s st z w s2

hints: Only `needs` has to change. For a load or an op it is already right. For a store, the answer is its sources plus some more names.
A store overwrites the version in `version`. Walk over `nodes` and pick every node whose kind is `"load"` and whose version is the same one.
`out = list(srcs)`, then `if kind == "store": out += [n[0] for n in nodes if n[1] == "load" and n[2] == version]`, then `return out`.
explain: `visit` prints a node only after everything in `needs`. The reference adds one thing to a store's needs: every load of the version that store overwrites. So those loads are printed first, while the old values are still in the array. Loads of other versions are left alone, which matters: a load of the new version has to come after the store.
